text: Triggers can automatically draft replies when emails arrive, add team comments, and organize threads into todos
quote: Set up triggers to draft replies when emails arrive, add comments for your team, organize threads into todos, and connect to 3,000+ other apps.

text: Zapier integration connects Shortwave to thousands of other services
quote: Zapier: Connect to thousands of other services

text: The AI can browse the web for current information related to your emails
quote: Allow the AI to browse the web to get the latest information related to your emails

text: Add custom integrations by pointing the AI at any MCP server, including ones you build yourself
quote: You can connect virtually any application through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Just click "Add custom integration" and point to an MCP server of your choice — or even create your own.

text: AI Integrations connect the assistant to Slack, Calendar, Notion, Asana, HubSpot and more to automate workflows from the inbox
quote: Connect the AI to your Slack, Calendar, Notion, Asana, Hubspot, and more so you can automate workflows without ever leaving your inbox.

text: The GitHub integration lets the AI check repositories and manage issues
quote: GitHub: Check repositories and manage issues

text: AI Snippets let you define an email template once and reuse it
quote: AI Snippets let you define an email template once upfront and then re-use it whenever you need it.

text: Snippets support {AI placeholders} that the AI fills in automatically
quote: You just need to add instructions using `{AI placeholders}` and the AI will automatically fill them out.

text: AI Snippets can be shared to build a team-wide library of common email content
quote: By sharing AI Snippets with your team, you can build a team-wide library of common email content to help everyone work smarter and faster.

text: Scheduled send lets you set a future send time for a message
quote: Scheduled send gives you the ability to send an email at a future time. All you have to do is write a message, set a send time, and then move on to your next task.

text: The send scheduler accepts natural-language times
quote: Shortwave's scheduler uses the power of natural language to give you maximum control over when your email gets sent.

text: Undo send reverts a sent message back to a draft
quote: Undo send staves off the panic you feel when you accidentally send a message that wasn't ready by allowing you to revert a sent message back to a draft.

text: Splits divide the inbox into multiple focused inboxes, each in its own tab
quote: They’re a simple way to divide your one big inbox into multiple smaller, more focused inboxes – each in its own tab.

text: Splits can be defined by importance, built-in or custom labels, specific senders, or complex search queries
quote: You can define Splits based on: Importance, Built-in labels... Custom labels, Specific senders, Complex search queries

text: Team comments let you privately discuss an email with teammates inside Shortwave
quote: Team comments let you privately discuss an email with your team directly in Shortwave, so you can plan how to respond together, and easily keep all the relevant people in the loop.

text: @mentioning a teammate in a comment gives them access to both the comment and the email
quote: Something special happens when you `@mention` a teammate in a comment – they suddenly get access to not just your comment, but the email too

text: Email subjects appear bold when there are unread team comments
quote: Email subjects now appear bold when there are unread team comments, making collaboration more visible

text: The AI assistant can read threads, write drafts, search your entire email history, and check your calendar
quote: it can read threads, write drafts, search your entire email history, check your calendar, and more.

text: Tab-to-complete AI writing suggestions appear as you draft, based on your previous emails
quote: Just press 'tab' to complete. These AI suggestions are intelligent and based on previous emails you've written, so they sound just like you

text: The AI learns your voice and style from your sent mail so it can write emails that sound like you
quote: Our AI learns your unique voice and style from the emails you send, so it can write emails that sound just like you

text: Instant Summaries appear at the top of email threads as soon as you open them
quote: Instant Summaries show up at the very top of your email threads the **instant** you open them.

text: Instant Summaries are available on desktop, iOS, and Android for all users, including the free plan
quote: Instant Summaries are available on ALL platforms (Desktop, iOS, and Android) for ALL our users. That's right, even if you're on our free plan.

text: Custom AI filters written in plain English can automatically label, star, archive, and more
quote: Take control of your inbox with custom AI filters. Automatically label, star, archive, and more with scripts you write in plain English.

text: Choose AI intelligence levels from Basic (Claude Haiku 4.5) up to Expert (Claude Opus 4.6 with adaptive thinking)
quote: Choose between Basic (Claude Haiku 4.5), Standard (Claude Sonnet 4.6), Advanced (Claude Sonnet 4.6 with adaptive thinking), and Expert (Claude Opus 4.6 with adaptive thinking) intelligence levels

text: The Tasklet integration acts on emails automatically, with its drafts appearing in Shortwave
quote: Shortwave now integrates with Tasklet to take action on your emails automatically. Drafts appear right in Shortwave—not buried in Gmail.

text: Identify important emails and todos with one click and sweep away the rest
quote: Identify important emails & todos with a single click. Sweep away the rest.

text: Apps are available on iOS, Android, Mac, and Windows
quote: No credit card required. Available on iOS, Android, Mac & Windows

text: Migration guides cover moving from Gmail, Spark, and Superhuman
quote: Migrating from Gmail Migrating from Spark Migrating from Superhuman

text: Shortwave imports your last 90 days of email
quote: Shortwave imports your last 90 days of emai

text: Press Shift+? to open the keyboard shortcut reference
quote: Type Shift `?` to open the key

text: Search operators let you locate specific threads and messages
quote: Search operators in Shortwave make locating threads and messages simple.

text: The AI assistant can read, summarize, and analyze PDFs, text, code, and other file types
quote: Read, summarize, and analyze PDF, text, code, and other file types with the AI Assistant

text: You can ask the AI assistant to remember facts and preferences to customize its behavior
quote: Customize the behavior of your AI assistant by asking it to remember facts & preferences

text: AI web browsing is enabled by default for paid plans
quote: AI web browsing enabled by default: Now automatically on for paid plans

text: Gmail filters or Shortwave auto-apply rules can automatically label emails, and Splits can be based on those labels.
quote: For even more power, you can use Gmail filters or Shortwave’s auto-apply rules to apply a label automatically to emails, and then create a Split based on that label.

text: Shortwave supports Gmail's Importance feature.
quote: As part of this launch, we’re introducing support for Gmail’s Importance feature.

text: Mentioning a teammate in a comment notifies that teammate.
quote: If you want to loop in someone else on your team, all you have to do is `@mention` them in the comment (i.e. `@Marcus`), and they’ll be notified as well.

text: Real-time typing indicators show when other people are commenting.
quote: When other people are commenting, you’ll also see real-time typing indicators, so you can coordinate and avoid stepping on each other’s toes.
